rationale: All four Toffolis target q4, and the CNOTs between them only XOR into q4, so they commute and can be merged. Their combined effect is q4 ^= q0q3+q2q3+q1q2+q0q1 = (q0^q2)(q1^q3), which is a single Toffoli on two parities. That Toffoli is done in T0 with one 4-T Gidney AND into a fresh ancilla, uncomputed by X-measurement plus a CZ fix-up and a reset; T1-T3 become identity, giving 4 T in total.
